_note: Rough inputs accepted by the user on 2026-10-17. Status: validated, dated (source read, year stated), assumption (rough, to be replaced), or unresolved (placeholder until the gate resolution run reports). Ranges drive the sensitivity tables. Currency noted per field.

shelf_price_sgd_per_can.source: Observed Singapore zero or sparkling can prices, 17 Oct 2026 (RedMart and FairPrice captures): S$0.82 to S$1.71 per 330 ml. Singha zero citrus at RedMart S$39.90 per 24 cans (20 percent off, about S$1.66). The earlier S$34.90 FairPrice listing was not reproduced. Base is the middle of the observed comparable range

gst_rate.source: GST rate used in the gate track; IRAS page not read in full

retailer_margin.source: Proxy: Sheng Siong FY2025 gross margin 31.3% (grocery, Singapore). A chain-level margin, not beverage-specific

importer_margin.source: Rough importer or distributor margin on its selling price

bcrs_deposit_sgd_per_can.source: BCRS deposit is a pass-through: retailers charge the S$0.10 deposit to buyers at checkout (NEA page), so it is not an importer cost. The high case tests an importer that absorbs it

bcrs_producer_fee_sgd_per_can.source: Producer fee of 3 to 4 cents per container paid to BCRS Ltd (ministerial reply, 3 Feb 2026). The Singapore importer registers as producer for overseas-made goods

cif_realised_sgd_per_can.source: Bracket from Comtrade HS 220210, 2025: Singapore mirror import from Thailand USD 0.2859 per 330 ml can (CIF convention) and Thai export USD 0.4333 per can (FOB convention). Base is the mid-point, USD 0.36, times 1.33. A category unit value, not a Singha price; the sixfold gap between export and mirror is unexplained

exworks_usd_per_can.source: Rough Thai cost for 330 ml can including ingredients, packaging and filling; no quote

freight_20ft_usd.source: Rough Thailand to Singapore 20 ft container; the vendor indicative USD 172.8 to 217.8 per 20 ft is not used because its basis looks implausible for a full container

cartons_per_20ft.source: Rough 24 x 330 ml cartons per 20 ft container

cans_per_carton.source: Pack size of the FairPrice listing

duty_rate.source: Customs dutiable list: soft drinks non-dutiable, GST applies; confirm per SKU

trade_spend_share.source: Promotions and listing support as a share of CIF price

fixed_cost_sgd_per_year.source: Brand marketing, one sales and account role, samples, travel, compliance upkeep

one_off_setup_sgd.source: Labelling, Nutri-Grade consultancy, trademark filing, samples

category_volume_cans.source: Derived: MarketLine carbonated soft drinks, Singapore, 135.9m litres in 2021 (vendor, Feb 2023 edition), divided by 0.33 litre per can. Vendor-derived, 2021 base

shelf_price_krw_per_can.source: GS25 list price, 355 ml can, convenience store (from the Korea gate track); convenience store is an upper reference for supermarket price

sugar_levy_krw_per_can.source: Korean sugar-levy draft (Kim Yoon bill, JoongAng Daily, 17 Sep 2026) would tax sugar-substitute drinks up to 50 won per litre; 0.355 litre per can gives about 18 won per can. Base assumes no levy; high case applies the draft

vat_rate.source: Standard Korean VAT rate, to confirm in the Korea G2 or G3 resolution

retailer_margin.source: Proxy: BGF Retail beverage-blended gross margin about 18.7% (2024, provisional) and GS Retail implied 24.8 to 26.8% (2024). Not beverage-specific; the importer margin itself is unverifiable

tariff_rate.source: Korea Customs FTA portal, read in the Korea G2 resolution: ASEAN-Korea FTA 0% on HS 2202.10.10, 2202.10.90 and 2202.99.90 for Thai origin with origin proof; MFN 8% applies if origin proof fails. Thailand-Korea bilateral is not in force. Import licence check (MOTIE) not closed

cif_realised_krw_per_can.source: Proxy: UN Comtrade HS 220210 Thai-origin unit value into Korea, USD 1.1091 per kg (2025), times 0.355 kg per can, times KRW 1,342 per USD. Thai basket of brands, not Singha price; includes freight. High end is the back-solved importer ceiling from step 4

exworks_usd_per_can.source: Same Thai cost as Singapore, rough

freight_20ft_usd.source: Proxy: expired Bangkok to Busan LCL quotes of USD 68 to 78 per CBM (Flexport snippet, valid to August and September 2026) times about 28 CBM per 20 ft. No current Laem Chabang or 20 ft quote found

trade_spend_share.source: Promotions and listing support as a share of CIF price

fixed_cost_krw_per_year.source: Brand marketing, one sales role, samples, compliance upkeep

category_volume_cans.source: Derived: MarketLine South Korea carbonated soft drinks, 2,094.4m litres in 2024 (vendor teaser), divided by 0.355 litre per can. Does not use the company's 29.1m litre figure

wacc.source: Rough discount rate for a small regional beverage export venture

ramp_share_base.source: Share of category volume in years 1 to 5 in the base case; the bull and bear cases scale it

bull_multiplier.source: Share multiplier in the bull case

bear_multiplier.source: Share multiplier in the bear case
